notes.title: VR Funhouse 1.3 Release!
notes.content:
Winter Arrives for VR Funhouse: Winter Wonderland Mod, Steam Achievements and More!

As the weather gets cold, get cozy under the bigtop and have some fun with our latest release! 

Steam Achievements!

Today, we’ve released 45 Steam achievements for VR Funhouse. Each game now has three high scores to beat, along with some zany extra achievements. Try your hand at unlocking them all, but be wary, that is no small feat!

 Winter Wonderland!

Brrrr! It's chilly in the Funhouse!  Download	 the Winter Wonderland Mod, where we've added a seasonal dash of snow to the Funhouse you know and love.

Enjoy frosty new takes on your favorite Funhouse games, all while shivering in your boots!

It's frozen fun for everyone!

Mod Contest, Modkit, and Github!

Make sure you join in on the active mod contest! With tons of real prizes, it's not to be missed! 
 Visit here for more details! 

Both the modkit and our github branch of VR Funhouse are being updated, so you've got all the tools you need!

notes.title: VR Funhouse 1.2.3 Patch
notes.content: We received reports that the game can suffer from performance issues after playing for an extended amount of time.  We've addressed that and an infrequent crash on exit with this latest patch.  Have fun punching those moles!

notes.title: Version 1.2 update!
notes.content:
Welcome back to the VR Funhouse! We’ve been tinkering under the big top to add two new levels and to make the funhouse a standing experience!

NEW GAMES!

HotShot Basketball!

See if you can spin the ball on your fingertips, master your dribbling skills, and drain as many shots as possible in 60 seconds! In HotShot Basketball, we’ve created the traditional arcade basketball experience!

Wall Walker Toss

They’re FLEX-ible, they’re sticky and they’re slightly whacky. Squeeze and squish these little critters and see if you can get them to stick on the target! Feel free to throw multiple walkers at once, it’s a bushel of sticky walkers!

New Accessibility Options

We’ve now added teleportation and remote grabbing to the funhouse. We now fully support the standing experience and hope this gives you the freedom you need!

Refer to the in game boards in the introductory level to see how to use these new features.

ModKit Update

We've updated the ModKit to the latest version on the Epic Games Launcher! Go grab it and get to modding!

Have fun and we’ll see you in the funhouse!

notes.title: Funhouse 1.1.1 Patch
notes.content:
We’ve made a quick update to include a fix to the audio system. The audio listener was displaced from the HMD in the most recent update and this has now been fixed.  The VR Funhouse Mod Kit will also be patched today to reflect the changes to the source asset.

Note: All previous versions of the game are available at any time in the beta tab of Steam. Simply go to Properties -> Betas and select any previous version.

Thanks for playing and modding!

notes.title: Modding comes to the Funhouse!
notes.content:
Welcome to modding in the Funhouse!

With our latest update, VR Funhouse now supports mods, giving the community a sandbox of possibilities for fun in VR.  Now you can play, create, play again and even share your VR creations with the world.
 
Swap out your shooting gallery pistol for a Tommy gun, whack the moles while their hair is on fire, or build your favorite mini-game in VR.  With VR Funhouse mods the possibilities are endless.
 

If you’re a modder, download the VR Funhouse Mod Kit, create your own mods, and share them with the world.

Install the Epic Game Launcher, go to the Modding Tab, and click VR Funhouse!


If you’re a gamer, visit the VR Funhouse Steam Workshop page, subscribe to one of the mod experiences created by the community, and add it to your game. NVIDIA has even created a few of our own mods for you to enjoy. They include:

Tommy Gun: Swap out your shooting gallery pistols for a Tommy gun and take on the Shooting Gallery and Cannon Skeet 
Super Whack-A-Mole: Whack moles in 360 degrees.
Big Top: Cover your carnival with a colorful circus tent. 
Zero Gravity Goo: Shoot colorful clowns with slow-motion goo. 
Great Moles of Fire: Box moles with their hair on fire.


We want the VR and modding community to help us create brand new amazing experiences in the Funhouse. So have fun and happy modding!
